what: Digests of the distinctive numbers and timestamps of every value removed from the tree under docs/platform/programme/DECISIONS-2026-09-28.md §3 and docs/platform/programme/DECISIONS-2026-09-29.md §2 (strip.py beside this file; TOKENS there says what a token is). "gone": no data file and nothing under src/ holds them, and scripts/swiss-output-guard.test.mjs fails if one comes back. "kept": they still appear there, as the inputs, reference values and statistics SWISS-OUTPUT-REMOVAL.md lists.
digest: the first 16 hexadecimal digits of the SHA-256 of the canonical token in UTF-8
